notes: Hand-authored ineffective rollback: the forward proposal both raises replicas (3 to 5, keeping capacity headroom) and widens the rollout budget (maxUnavailable 25% to 50%). The rollback operation restores replicas to 3 but deliberately leaves maxUnavailable at 50% instead of reverting it to 25%, so replaying the forward and rollback operations on a sandboxed copy does not reproduce the original state.

proposal.summary: Scale the notification Deployment from 3 to 5 replicas and widen its rollout maxUnavailable from 25% to 50% ahead of a marketing campaign.

diagnosis.likelyCause: Forecast campaign traffic requires more notification capacity and a faster rollout budget to keep pace with frequent releases during the campaign window.
assumptions: The campaign traffic forecast holds and the wider rollout budget is reverted once the campaign window ends.

operations.reason: Scale up capacity and widen the rollout budget ahead of the marketing campaign's forecast traffic.

verificationSteps.description: Confirm current notification replica count and rollout budget before scaling up.
Confirm all 5 replicas are ready and serving notification traffic without error-rate increase after scaling up.
